response.sql: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(1.0 * HGB / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS average_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS average_excess_ratio FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio

assumptions.assumption: A lab record with zero HCT has an undefined ratio and is excluded from that patient's ratio average.
